Small orange eyes beneath a deep dark brow. Adult unmasked means the outer biomask removed but the silver/olive metallic mouth respirator PROSTHESIS remains, as in the licensed reference. Very long dark organic cranial dreadlocks gathered and braided down the back; a restrained terminal mace can be attached for armed adults. This bundle starts at the HEAD and is NOT a pelvic or spinal tail. Shoulder/back spikes are worn armor, never an invented biological dorsal spine. Five-finger hands, classic-like plantigrade body. For infants and juveniles: short soft cranial tendrils, small emerging horn buds; any bare four-mandible mouth is explicitly an original reconstruction, not documented canon. Couronne biologique ivoire et reliefs frontaux concentriques. La longue tresse vient du crâne, jamais du bassin. Respirateur buccal de costume conservé si requis par la base.
